notes.decision: Core OKX crypto exchange/custody/transfer posture for Poland is candidate available_with_limits based on exact Poland launch plus Poland-listed policy, not foreign licence alone.

Keep regulatory regimes separate: KNF payment notification for OKX Europe Limited and KNF investment-firm notification for OKX Europe Markets Limited are Poland-specific but do not substitute for each other or for product/account eligibility.
Polish-language OKX pages and PLN P2P surfaces are reachability/product-surface evidence, not standalone legal authority.
KYC is required for relevant OKX Europe services; it is a requirement, not country-availability proof by itself.
PLN P2P buy/sell is publicly supported with limitations; direct PLN bank deposit/withdrawal remains not verified.
EUR SEPA deposit/withdrawal is supported with EEA/account limitations; Poland payment notification is separate regulator evidence.
Poland investment layer is available_with_limits at research level only from Poland KNF notification plus OKX product eligibility rules; exact account eligibility remains conditional.
EEA referral program exists but rewards and regional eligibility are dynamic; no fixed Poland reward or CBW Poland binding is authorized.
Owner-confirmed global OKX link/code remains independent from Poland MarketProfile/offer authority.
